_meta.source: Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service (CAMS) global atmospheric composition forecasts, via the Open-Meteo Air Quality API (domain 'cams_global')
_meta.licence: CC BY 4.0 (Open-Meteo); contains modified Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service information
_meta.attribution: Air-quality data by Open-Meteo.com (CC BY 4.0); Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service (CAMS)
_meta.windowNote: Archive begins 2022-08-04; this is the longest span of complete 12-month years available at retrieval (4 samples per calendar month).
_meta.method: One request per city, hourly PM2.5 (µg/m³) in local time. Per calendar month: mean of the per-year monthly means (years weighted equally; a year-month needs >= 80% hourly coverage). yearMin/yearMax = spread of those per-year monthly means.
_meta.caveat: CAMS global is ~0.4° (~45 km) model output (forecast archive with data assimilation of satellite AOD, not ground stations). It smooths and generally under-resolves urban hotspots, traffic/heating-driven winter smog in basins (e.g. Skopje, Sarajevo) and local agricultural burning; it can also overestimate desert-dust PM2.5. Treat as a regional background estimate, not a city-centre measurement.
